skill_addendum.note: ECR is a regional service. Evaluate findings ONLY for the audited region unless evidence explicitly shows otherwise.

item.name: repositories.json
item.use_for: Repository-level controls: public access, immutability, scan-on-push, encryption, lifecycle policies

item.name: registry.json
item.use_for: Registry-level controls: scanning configuration, registry policy, replication configuration

anti_hallucination.rule: Evidence references MUST be resolvable. Use JSON Pointer fragments (RFC 6901) where possible. Examples: repositories.json#/repositories/0, registry.json#/registry_scanning.
Do NOT claim a repository is public unless the repository policy explicitly contains a wildcard principal (Principal '*' or AWS '*') in an Allow statement.

If registry scanning evidence is missing or contains an error (AccessDenied / UnsupportedOperationInSDK / other), do NOT generate ECR-004. Instead, generate ECR-010 (low severity) and clearly state "insufficient evidence".
For rotation/scanning interval-like findings: only generate them if the evidence includes the required configuration fields.

irrefutable_evidence_guide.requirement: Every ECR finding MUST include in evidence_snippet the exact AWS metadata:

key_fields.field: Image digest, scan status, and vulnerability counts

irrefutable_evidence_guide.general_rule: Do not make generic assertions. Include exact policy JSON and repository configuration from AWS API responses.
